title: Gold Fell 23% From Its Record. What Happened?
description:
COMEX gold futures closed at a record $5,318.40 an ounce on January 29, 2026. By November 6 they were at $4,074.90: down 23%. The worst day came on January 30, when gold fell 10.8% (silver 31%) as Kevin Warsh was named as the pick for Fed chair and the dollar rose. Since then, higher real interest rates, a stronger dollar and the Fed's first rate hike since 2023 pushed gold to a low of $3,898.90 on October 30 (-27%), while central banks kept buying: 321 tonnes in Q3, up 42%. We also look at gold vs stocks, the 2011-2015 gold bust, America's gold at Fort Knox, and whether gold is still a safe haven.
